title: Portfolio - Product Feedback Intelligence API
description: Local product feedback intelligence workflow: validates feedback intake, classifies theme/sentiment/urgency via an LLM-in-the-loop classifier with a deterministic fallback and confidence gate, derives urgency, scores priority, gates churn-risk/critical items for human review, and emits a redacted audit event.
notes: v0.2.0 wires a live Ollama classifier path (HTTP to host.docker.internal:11434, model llama3.2:3b), selected per request via classifierMode='ollama' and verified end-to-end. The deterministic stub remains the default so CI and the 10-fixture behavioral eval stay offline and reproducible (still 10/10). The confidence gate falls back to the keyword classifier on low-confidence or invalid model output.
